photos.alt: A red balcony full of flowers above a shuttered corner shop.
Palm trees on a stone terrace below a wooded hillside.
Stone columns holding up a white mosaic ceiling.
Crowds on the mosaic stairs of Park Güell, below a columned terrace.
Pans of black rice and vegetable paella on a checked tablecloth.
A souvenir shop doorway hung with magnets and novelty license plates.
Pigeons around a café table with a cup of coffee on it.
The spires of the Sagrada Família rising above green trees.
Sculptures and a white cross among the towers of the Sagrada Família.
The wavy stone balconies of Casa Milà against a blue sky.
Street signs pointing to Passeig de Gràcia, Casa Batlló and La Pedrera.
A long avenue of stone buildings under a bright blue sky.
A street at dusk under a dark teal sky, with a Hola Sant Adrià banner.
The CCIB convention centre beside a glass office tower, with two people walking up the ramp.
The yellow upper floors of a courtyard building against the night sky.
A lamp-lit arcade with people sitting at café tables at night.
A lit shrine on a stone corner above the street signs for Sant Sever and Santa Eulàlia.
The Gothic façade of a cathedral lit up at night.
A person leaning against the wall of a narrow lamp-lit alley at night.
A cardboard box stamped MADE IN SPAIN against a plain wall.
Pedestrians on a wet street beside a large lit stone building at night.
Bunches of vine tomatoes in a green crate.
People at a busy street corner beside a taxi sign, among stone buildings.
A bar with wide windows overlooking the city at dusk.
Looking down on a city block at night, over treetops and parked cars.
Two colourful cocktails with fruit, seen from above on a dark table.
An empty metro platform and tunnel, with a sign showing the next train.
A deserted street washed in yellow light from curved street lamps.
A hazy view across city rooftops to distant towers and hills.
A bright blue Royal Dutch Airlines plane on the ground, seen through a window.
